messages.recipient_title: Chief Sustainability Officer and Chief Compliance Officer
messages.subject: For Øistein Jensen | Sustainability, Compliance & External Stakeholder Governance | Executive Proposal
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Jensen,

I am writing from Guyana, where I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My work spans ESG, government relations, regulatory coordination, compliance interfaces, stakeholder governance and executive issue management within a major multinational industrial operation.

Odfjell's integration of sustainability, compliance, safety and fleet-transition priorities is strongly aligned with the problems I work on today: converting external commitments into accountable internal action, maintaining defensible evidence, anticipating regulatory and stakeholder risks and coordinating across operational and corporate functions.

I prepared an Odfjell-specific Strategic Value Creation Proposal rather than sending a conventional CV alone. It sets out where I would add value across sustainability governance, compliance coordination, external affairs, stakeholder intelligence and transition execution. My three-page Executive CV forms the final section.

I am open to relocation to Norway and employer-supported work authorization. My strongest fit would be a Director, Head or senior leadership mandate spanning Sustainability, ESG, Compliance, External Affairs, Government Relations, Responsible Business or strategic stakeholder management.

I would value a short confidential conversation. If another senior leader owns the most relevant mandate, I would be grateful if you would route the proposal internally.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
ragunauthramsaroop.com

strategic_brief.title: Strategic Value Creation Proposal: Sustainability, Compliance and External Stakeholder Governance
strategic_brief.prepared_for_title: Chief Sustainability Officer and Chief Compliance Officer
strategic_brief.executive_summary: Odfjell's sustainability agenda is closely connected to fleet transition, safety, responsible business, compliance and access to capital. Delivering those commitments requires disciplined governance across technical, commercial, regulatory and stakeholder interfaces. I bring director-level experience from a multinational resource operation where ESG, government relations, regulatory coordination, compliance interfaces and external commitments must be translated into accountable operating action. My contribution would be to strengthen the link between sustainability ambition, evidence, institutional engagement and cross-functional execution, while giving leadership earlier visibility of material external risks and clearer ownership of commitments across a complex international operating environment.
strategic_brief.company_context: Odfjell is a global chemical tanker and terminal company headquartered in Bergen, with sustainability and compliance represented directly in executive management. The company has established ambitious decarbonisation goals, issued sustainability-linked financing and continues to invest in fleet efficiency, technology and responsible operations. Its current corporate structure combines a Chief Sustainability Officer role with Chief Compliance Officer responsibilities, signalling an integrated approach to non-financial risk and long-term value protection. Shipping also operates under rapidly evolving environmental regulation, customer expectations, financing standards and international stakeholder scrutiny. A strong operating model therefore needs to connect sustainability targets, compliance controls, regulatory intelligence, external commitments and site-level execution through clear ownership, evidence and escalation.

opportunities.title: Integrated sustainability and compliance governance
opportunities.rationale: Sustainability commitments and compliance obligations often touch the same operating processes, data owners and decision-makers. Managing them through separate systems can create duplication, weak accountability and inconsistent escalation when issues cross functional boundaries.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would strengthen an integrated governance model linking material commitments, compliance obligations, evidence requirements, responsible owners and executive escalation through one disciplined review architecture.

opportunities.title: Regulatory and stakeholder intelligence
opportunities.rationale: International shipping is exposed to changing emissions rules, port requirements, customer standards and public expectations. Local developments can materially affect fleet, commercial and reputation decisions before they become visible through formal reporting channels.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would build concise institutional and stakeholder intelligence that ranks external developments by materiality, assigns response ownership and connects regulatory signals to leadership decisions and operating priorities.

opportunities.title: Evidence behind transition commitments
opportunities.rationale: Sustainability-linked financing and public climate targets increase the importance of defensible source data, traceability and internal control over non-financial claims. Evidence quality affects both external credibility and management confidence.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would strengthen evidence ownership and assurance readiness by applying experience from carbon-data governance, renewable-energy reporting and cross-functional ESG verification in a regulated industrial setting.

opportunities.title: External commitment execution
opportunities.rationale: Global operators accumulate commitments across regulators, customers, financiers, partners and communities. Execution risk grows when promises are not translated into accountable tasks, measurable milestones and documented closure.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would implement a practical commitments register and executive review rhythm that connects external promises to owners, due dates, evidence, escalation thresholds and closure records.

days_0_30: Map material sustainability, compliance and stakeholder commitments across selected corporate and operating interfaces.
Identify gaps in ownership, source evidence and escalation.
days_31_60: Introduce a pilot integrated commitment and issue register.
Build a stakeholder and regulatory intelligence map for priority transition and responsible-business topics.
days_61_90: Use live sustainability and compliance issues to test the framework and improve executive visibility.
Deliver a dashboard covering commitments, evidence status, material external developments and management actions.
days_91_180: Scale the operating rhythm across additional functions or markets.
Measure results through closure discipline, assurance readiness, reduced issue recurrence and stakeholder outcomes.

potential_impact: Stronger accountability across sustainability and compliance commitments.
Earlier visibility of regulatory and stakeholder developments affecting fleet and commercial decisions.
Improved evidence quality supporting climate, ESG and responsible-business claims.
Faster cross-functional resolution of material external issues.
background_relevance: Director-level experience across ESG, government relations, regulatory coordination, social responsibility, corporate affairs and executive advisory inside a multinational mining operation.
Experience coordinating external obligations and commitments across Environment, HSE, Legal, Finance, Operations, Procurement, HR, Security and technical teams.
Practical experience with carbon-data governance, renewable-energy implementation and source-evidence traceability in a regulated industrial environment.
Senior engagement with regulators and public institutions, with responsibility for issue resolution, stakeholder confidence and internal follow-through.
